description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeManager's command extraction functionality, including various scenarios for when commands are expected to be correctly or incorrectly extracted based on trigger words and timing constraints.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManagerExtractCommandTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases for verifying the behavior of VoiceWakeManager's command extraction logic.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNoTriggerFound
methods.description: Tests that the command extraction returns nil when the trigger word is not present in the transcript.

methods.name: extractCommandTrimsTokensAndResult
methods.description: Tests that the command is correctly extracted and whitespace is trimmed when the trigger is found.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenGapTooShort
methods.description: Verifies that extraction fails when the minimum gap after trigger is not met.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNothingAfterTrigger
methods.description: Checks that no command is returned if the trigger is at the end of the transcript with no subsequent words.

methods.name: extractCommandIgnoresEmptyTriggers
methods.description: Ensures that empty or whitespace-only trigger strings are ignored during extraction.
